author: Rafinesque, 1810

note.en: A large, rarely seen oceanic fish that eats jellyfish and drifts near the surface; known here only as a regional record.
note.es: Un pez oceánico grande y poco visto que come medusas y deriva cerca de la superficie; aquí solo se conoce como registro regional.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic, with no local sighting reports found

marks.en: Deep oval silvery-blue body with reddish fins and a small mouth.
marks.es: Cuerpo alto y ovalado azul plateado, con aletas rojizas y boca pequeña.
